14bool FStateTreeCharacterGroundedCondition::TestCondition(FStateTreeExecutionContext& Context) const
15{
16 const FInstanceDataType& InstanceData = Context.GetInstanceData(*this);
17
18 // is the character currently grounded?
19 bool bCondition = InstanceData.Character->GetMovementComponent()->IsMovingOnGround();
20
21 return InstanceData.bMustBeOnAir ? !bCondition : bCondition;
22}

33EStateTreeRunStatus FStateTreeComboAttackTask::EnterState(FStateTreeExecutionContext& Context, const FStateTreeTransitionResult& Transition) const
34{
35 // have we transitioned from another state?
36 if (Transition.ChangeType == EStateTreeStateChangeType::Changed)
37 {
38 // get the instance data
39 FInstanceDataType& InstanceData = Context.GetInstanceData(*this);
40
41 // bind to the on attack completed delegate
42 InstanceData.Character->OnAttackCompleted.BindLambda(
43 [WeakContext = Context.MakeWeakExecutionContext()]()
44 {
45 WeakContext.FinishTask(EStateTreeFinishTaskType::Succeeded);
46 }
47 );
48
49
50 // tell the character to do a combo attack
51 InstanceData.Character->DoAIComboAttack();
52 }
53
54 return EStateTreeRunStatus::Running;
55}

264EStateTreeRunStatus FStateTreeGetPlayerInfoTask::Tick(FStateTreeExecutionContext& Context, const float DeltaTime) const
265{
266 // get the instance data
267 FInstanceDataType& InstanceData = Context.GetInstanceData(*this);
268
269 // get the character possessed by the first local player
270 InstanceData.TargetPlayerCharacter = Cast<ACharacter>(UGameplayStatics::GetPlayerPawn(InstanceData.Character, 0));
271
272 // do we have a valid target?
273 if (InstanceData.TargetPlayerCharacter)
274 {
275 // update the last known location
276 InstanceData.TargetPlayerLocation = InstanceData.TargetPlayerCharacter->GetActorLocation();
277 }
278
279 // update the distance
280 InstanceData.DistanceToTarget = FVector::Distance(InstanceData.TargetPlayerLocation, InstanceData.Character->GetActorLocation());
281
282 return EStateTreeRunStatus::Running;
283}
